title: Import contacts from untrusted JSON text with a per-record report
prompt:
Add a new feature src/main/features/contacts that imports contacts from a JSON file. Its index.ts exports importContacts(path: string, readText: (path: string) => Promise<string>, writer: { readonly write: (text: string) => void }): Promise<ImportResult>. It calls readText(path), treats the text as untrusted input (zod is installed in the project), and writes a report to the writer. Each report line is passed to writer.write as one call and ends with '\n'.

The file must hold a JSON array. Each element is one record. A record is valid when it is an object whose 'name' is a string that is non-empty after trimming and whose 'email' is a string that, after trimming and lower-casing, has no whitespace, one '@', a non-empty part before it, and a domain after it that contains a dot. Other properties are ignored. An imported contact is { name, email } with the trimmed name and the normalized email. Records are de-duplicated by normalized email: the first valid record wins, and later ones with the same email are rejected. Imported contacts keep their input order.

Each rejected record gets a reason: 'not an object' (null, an array, a string, a number or a boolean), 'invalid name', 'invalid email' (when both fields are bad, 'invalid name' wins), or 'duplicate of #<index>' where <index> is the 0-based index of the record that was kept. A rejected record does not claim its email.

ImportResult is a discriminated union on 'kind', and importContacts resolves to it (it never throws for these cases):
- { kind: 'imported', contacts: readonly { name: string; email: string }[], rejected: readonly { index: number; reason: string }[] }, with 'rejected' ordered by index;
- { kind: 'read-failed', message: string }, when readText rejects. The message is the Error's message, or String(value) when the rejection is not an Error;
- { kind: 'malformed-json' }, when the text is not valid JSON;
- { kind: 'not-an-array' }, when the JSON is valid but is not an array.

Report lines, in this order:
- 'imported': 'Imported <n> contacts' (always the plural word, including for 0 and 1), then one 'Rejected #<index>: <reason>' line per rejected record.
- 'read-failed': the single line 'Could not read <path>: <message>'.
- 'malformed-json': the single line 'Malformed JSON in <path>'.
- 'not-an-array': the single line 'Expected a JSON array in <path>'.

Also export importContactsMain(path: string): Promise<void> from src/main/composition-root.ts. It runs importContacts with a reader built on readFile(file, 'utf8') from node:fs/promises and a writer that writes to process.stdout. Do not change the greeting feature or the existing main export. Add tests for every outcome in test/contacts.test.ts. Run nitpicker-gate until it exits 0.
